name: Citadel Packaging Company
old_description: Citadel Packaging is a distributor of rigid container and packaging materials. We are a young company, founded in 2018, but we have the knowledge and expertise of an industry veteran. Our headquarters are in Meridian, Idaho, but our products are shipped all over the world. We pride ourselves on providing excellent customer service and supplying our customers with the best possible products available on the market.
about:
Citadel Packaging Company was founded in 2018 in Meridian, Idaho, by an industry veteran who brought decades of packaging expertise to a new venture. The company operates as a distributor of rigid containers and closures, serving customers worldwide from its Idaho base.

The company stocks over 1,200 packaging products across categories that include plastic bottles and jars, glass bottles and jars, metal containers such as aluminum bottles and tins, and a wide range of closures including continuous-thread caps, dispensing caps, metal caps, and child-resistant caps. Orders ship within one to two business days, and volume pricing is displayed on every product page.

Citadel Packaging supplies startups, scaling brands, and established companies that need reliable packaging for consumer goods, food and beverage, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and industrial applications. The distributor works with brands that prioritize detail and quality in their packaging choices.

The company emphasizes personal service — “Real people. Real service.” — offering free samples on every product page, direct access to packaging specialists for bulk orders, and a commitment to helping customers find the right container and closure combinations.
